spec.title: Bytes sent
spec.description: Bytes written back to query callers.

spec.title: Requests
spec.description:
All HTTP and gRPC routes, Loki's own fan-out between components included; the Routes tab attributes it.
- Failures are counts per bucket on the right axis, stacked by class.
- `canceled` is the caller hanging up: `499`, or `cancel` on gRPC.
- `server error` is 5xx and gRPC `error`, the set `Error ratio` counts.

spec.title: p99 latency
spec.description:
The client-facing paths: the push API and the LogQL query API.
- `writes` rests on the 5 ms first bucket except during spikes; nothing inside that bucket can be separated.
- `Writes · Write latency` adds the mean; the Routes tab has every route.

Every HTTP and gRPC route over the whole range, the component's internal hops included; long-lived `Loop` and `Tail` streams are left out.
- `Traffic` scales each row to itself; compare magnitudes in `Requests`.
- A stream's duration is how long the connection stayed open.
- p99 rests on the 5 ms first bucket for most routes; `Mean` separates them.
- On a route with a handful of requests, p99 is the slowest one.
- `Canceled` is the caller hanging up: `499`, or `cancel` on gRPC.
- `Server errors` is 5xx and gRPC `error`, the set `Error ratio` counts.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (route, le) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route!~".*(Loop|Tail)"}[$__range])))
and on (route)
(sum by (route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count{route!~".*(Loop|Tail)"}[$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: Running versions
spec.description: A version live at any point in a bucket fills it, so two rows overlap across an upgrade.

spec.title: Bytes per tenant
spec.description:
Uncompressed volume received, lines later discarded included.
- A burst above `ingestion_rate_mb` is discarded as `rate_limited`.

spec.title: Stream churn
spec.description: Sustained creation with little removal means a label is carrying an unbounded value.

spec.title: Write latency
spec.description:
The push endpoint, as senders see it.
- p99 rests on the 5 ms first bucket except during spikes; nothing inside that bucket can be separated.

spec.title: Line length
spec.description:
Buckets step by a factor of 8, so each quantile is placed only within that factor.
- Lines longer than `max_line_size` are discarded as `line_too_long`.

spec.title: Chunks flushed by reason
spec.description:
`full` under 1% means every flush writes an undersized object.
- `idle` — `chunk_idle_period` with no writes.
- `max_age` — a `max_chunk_age` span of entry timestamps.
- `synced` — the hourly replica-alignment cut.
- `full` — the chunk reaching `chunk_target_size`.

spec.title: Chunk age at flush
spec.description:
Measured from the chunk's oldest entry, so late-arriving logs inflate it.
- The top bucket is 16 h, so a p99 resting there reads only "at least 16 h".
- A high value means a sender is shipping a backlog at least that old.

spec.title: Chunk utilisation
spec.description:
Compressed size at flush as a share of `chunk_target_size`, 1.5 MiB by default.
- Chunks flushing far under it mean streams idle out or churn before they fill, which costs index entries and read speed.

spec.title: Flush queue
spec.description:
Chunks waiting to be written to the object store.
- A growing queue means the object store is the bottleneck; failures mean it rejected the write.

spec.title: WAL health
spec.description:
Disk the WAL directory occupies, against the space it is allowed.
- A corruption or a disk-full failure means the ingester could not record writes it had already accepted, so a restart replays less than it acknowledged.

spec.title: LogQL latency by type
spec.description:
The histogram's first bucket is 250 ms: only the spikes above it are measurements, the baseline is interpolation.
- `limited` — a log query with label matchers only.
- `filter` — one that also carries a line filter.
- `metric` — a rate or count.

spec.title: Bytes processed / sec
spec.description:
Scan speed per query: bytes the engine scanned per second, averaged over each type's queries.
- Falling while latency rises points at the object store.

spec.title: Scheduler queue duration
spec.description:
Time a sub-query waited for a querier.
- Some wait is normal: the frontend dispatches up to `tsdb_max_query_parallelism` sub-queries against `max_concurrent` querier slots.
- The top bucket is 10 s, so a p99 resting there reads only "at least 10 s".

spec.title: Bytes received
spec.description:
Uncompressed volume across all tenants, structured metadata included.
- Counted as requests are parsed, so lines later discarded are included.
- Chunks are stored compressed, so the bucket holds less.

spec.title: Scheduler queue length
spec.description:
Sub-queries waiting for a querier, per tenant, at the peak of each bucket.
- Past `max_outstanding_requests_per_tenant`, the scheduler answers `429`.
- The frontend keeps at most `tsdb_max_query_parallelism` sub-queries outstanding per query, so reaching the ceiling takes many large queries at once.

spec.title: Object store latency by operation
spec.description: Mean time per request to S3; `Storage & Cache · Hedged requests` carries the tail.

spec.title: Object store operations
spec.description:
Requests per bucket by operation, failed ones on the right axis.
- Every failure mode records as 500, cancelled requests from abandoned queries included, so the failures track query volume as much as S3 health.
- The failures in `Compactor · Compaction and retention` are the unambiguous signal.

spec.title: Hedged requests
spec.description:
A duplicate request goes out when the first is still unanswered at `hedging.at`.
- `won` — the duplicate answered first.
- The line is `max_per_second`; at the line the cap is binding and further slow requests wait on the object store alone.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio
spec.description:
Hits over keys fetched, per cache.
- A cache asked a few hundred times swings with a single query; read the ratio against the request count.
- Misses on the most recent, still-changing part of a range are expected.

spec.title: Cache failures
spec.description:
Cache requests that failed, and values not stored for exceeding the client's `max_item_size`.
- A failed fetch is served from the store instead, so it costs latency, not data.

spec.title: Compaction and retention
spec.description:
Time since each job last succeeded, failed runs on the right axis.
- A climbing line with bars beneath it is a job failing and retrying.
- A climbing line with no bars is a job that stopped running.
- A gap covers the time before the first success after a restart.
- Both jobs read and write the object store, so failures here usually accompany failures there.

spec.title: Lines received / sec
spec.description:
Log lines across all tenants.
- Counted as requests are parsed, so lines later discarded are included.
- The number is the latest rate.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description:
With `GOMEMLIMIT` set, the Go runtime collects harder as the heap approaches it.
- Read `next GC target` against `Go heap in use`.
- RSS sits above the heap: it also covers stacks, mmap'ed chunks and allocator overhead.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description:
CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.
- Chunk compression and query sharding are the two CPU-bound paths.

spec.title: Status
spec.description:
Share of failed requests on each path.
- gRPC handlers report a named `error` status, which counts alongside 5xx.
- `Storage` is the share of chunks the ingester failed to write to the object store.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Sustained growth against a flat ingest and query rate is a leak.

spec.title: Run duration
spec.description:
Wall time of the most recent run.
- The value holds until the next run finishes, so the line steps.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/loki"}
|= `$contains`
| detected_level =~ `$errors_only`
| drop hostname, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport

spec.title: Discarded lines
spec.description: `Writes · Discarded by reason and tenant` splits them.

spec.expr:
topk(15, sum by (detected_level, msg) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/loki"}
  | logfmt msg
  | msg != ``
[$__range])))

spec.title: Oversized entries by stream
spec.description:
Entries rejected for exceeding `max_line_size`, one row per sending stream, with the largest entry it tried.
- `Discarded by reason and tenant` counts the same rejections as `line_too_long`.

spec.expr:
topk(20, sum by (host, name) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/loki"}
  |= `max entry size`
  | logfmt details
  | label_format host=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*host=\"([^\"]+)\".*$" .details "${1}" }}`, name=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*name=\"([^\"]+)\".*$" .details "${1}" }}`
  | host =~ `[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`
[$__range])))

max by (host, name) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/loki"}
  |= `max entry size`
  | logfmt details
  | label_format host=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*host=\"([^\"]+)\".*$" .details "${1}" }}`, name=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*name=\"([^\"]+)\".*$" .details "${1}" }}`
  | host =~ `[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+`
  | label_format bytes=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*with length '([0-9]+)' bytes.*$" .details "${1}" }}`
  | unwrap bytes [$__range]))

spec.title: Failed queries
spec.description:
LogQL queries that did not answer 200.
- `499` — the caller gave up before the answer.
- `429` — the scheduler queue ceiling, `Reads · Scheduler queue length`.
- Other `4xx` — Loki rejected the query as invalid or over a limit.
- `5xx` — Loki failed the query.

spec.title: Chunk size distribution
spec.description:
Share of flushed chunks per compressed size.
- A full chunk lands in `≥ 1.28 MB`: `chunk_target_size` is 1.5 MiB by default.
- The first bucket is 20 KB; `Lines per chunk` resolves the small end.

spec.title: Lines per chunk
spec.description:
Share of flushed chunks per line count.
- The first bucket is 200 lines; nothing below it can be separated.

spec.title: Retention sweep
spec.description:
Chunks past `retention_period` that compaction marked for deletion, and the sweeper deleting them after `retention_delete_delay`; failed deletes on the right axis.
- Marked without deleted for longer than the delay is a stuck sweeper.
- These counters appear at their first event, so the first batch after a restart reads 0.

spec.title: Delete requests
spec.description:
Requests from the delete API that are past their cancellation period and not yet processed, with the age of the oldest on the right axis.
- An age that keeps climbing is a delete the compactor is not getting to.
- `failures` counts failed delete phases of compaction.

spec.title: Error ratio
spec.description:
Server faults as a share of all requests.
- gRPC handlers report a named `error` status, which counts alongside 5xx.
- A 429 from a tenant at its stream limit is in `Overview · Discarded lines`.

spec.title: Streams per tenant
spec.description:
The line is `max_global_streams_per_user`, applied per tenant.
- A flat top touching the line is a clamped tenant.

spec.title: Discarded lines by reason
spec.description: `stream_limit` and `rate_limited` mean a limit you control is clamping a tenant; the rest are the sender's fault.

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only warnings and errors in the log. Lines Loki cannot classify are kept — their level is unknown, not low.

spec.name: contains
spec.label: Contains
spec.description: Substring the log line must contain, on top of the Errors only switch. Matches are highlighted.
